Mavoglurant Pharmacokinetics

Source: R/data.R
mavoglurant.Rd

Plasma concentration of mavoglurant (cp) in 120 subjects after an intravenous infusion of 10 min (20 min in one occasion); 78 subjects were dosed on two occasions. Time counts from the start of the infusion of each occasion.

Format

A data frame with 2427 rows, one per reading, and 13 columns:

name

"cp".

time

hours after the start of the infusion of the occasion.

value

the concentration.

sigma

NA throughout.

condition

subject and occasion, "<ID>_<OCC>".

ID, OCC

subject and occasion.

dose

the infused dose in mg, 25, 37.5 or 50.

duration

the duration of the infusion in hours, AMT / RATE of the source.

AGE, SEX, WT, HT

age (years), sex (1 or 2), weight (kg) and height (m).

Source

Package nlmixr2data, data set mavoglurant (GPL >= 3), the readings without the rows of missing values.

Wendling T, Tsamandouras N, Dumitras S, Pigeolet E, Ogungbenro K, Aarons L (2016), Reduction of a whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic model to stabilise the Bayesian analysis of clinical data. The AAPS Journal 18(1):196-209.

See also

The example project Theophylline, warfarin and mavoglurant fits a two-compartment model with variability between occasions.

Examples

data(mavoglurant)
head(mavoglurant)
#>   name  time value sigma condition  ID OCC dose  duration AGE SEX   WT       HT
#> 1   cp 0.200   491    NA     793_1 793   1   25 0.3333333  42   1 94.3 1.769997
#> 2   cp 0.250   605    NA     793_1 793   1   25 0.3333333  42   1 94.3 1.769997
#> 3   cp 0.367   556    NA     793_1 793   1   25 0.3333333  42   1 94.3 1.769997
#> 4   cp 0.533   310    NA     793_1 793   1   25 0.3333333  42   1 94.3 1.769997
#> 5   cp 0.700   237    NA     793_1 793   1   25 0.3333333  42   1 94.3 1.769997
#> 6   cp 1.200   147    NA     793_1 793   1   25 0.3333333  42   1 94.3 1.769997
